market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH ~$2,268 must drop ~34% to touch $1,500 by Dec 31, 2026 (8 months). ETH has higher beta than BTC and has been weak (already down from ~$2,315). Drawdown to $1,500 plausible but not most-likely path. Market 0.515 looks slightly high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: ETH-specific catalysts (ETF flows, network usage) and broad crypto drawdown depth.
